fields.summary_ko.0: Truist raised Walmart Inc. (WMT) price target from $114 to $134 and maintained a buy rating, indicating 6% upside from current price.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart CEO John Furner emphasized that the low-price strategy is a key driver of market share gains and increased customer demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: Walmart deserves a premium valuation due to growth in advertising, marketplace, and membership businesses, with 2027 net revenue growth guidance raised to 4.9–5.2%.
